concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-touchngo-ios-component]] — 2026-09-15 Touch'n Go iOS Components Sessions/Advanced add-on with Support setup, no extra method fields, v5+ InstantPaymentComponent versus v4.x.x TouchnGoComponent examples and live Support gate; setup is not payment-result proof.
warnings: The v5+ Sessions example delegates to session, while Advanced delegates to self; the v4.x.x example uses a different specialized component.
The page does not supply an app-return, details, webhook or final-outcome procedure; component initiation is not payment success.
